source_policy: The author package supplied county identifiers, county geometry, population, and COVID-19 outcomes only. This reconstruction did not download, read, or use author PM2.5, wildfire, smoke, weather, mobility, or merged-analysis fields.

aeris_exposure.assignment: nearest historical PM2.5 monitor to county bounding-box centroid within 100 km
aeris_exposure.aggregation: daily monitor value; planned 28-day mean over lags 0-28
aeris_exposure.selection: The first panel retained monitors assigned to the highest-population counties before exposure retrieval. It did not use author PM2.5 values or wildfire fields.

model_status.reason: The first Poisson fixed-effects model had a singular design matrix because the time-spline design duplicated the intercept. No substitute model was run.
model_status.planned_model: Poisson county-day model with log(population) offset, county fixed effects, six-degree calendar-time spline, and 28-day mean PM2.5.
